text:
Maya S (Support): FYI AcmeForms reported a regression after last night's scheduled deploy — long chat sessions suddenly stop obeying the system instruction around ~10k tokens.
Maya S (Support): They attached repro steps and a short transcript where the assistant abruptly changes persona.
Maya S (Support): Sample repro (they ran this against our hosted endpoint):
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <KEY>\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-70b-q4f","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant that always confirms the user's identity before giving account details."},{"role":"user","content":"Start session"},{"role":"assistant","content":"Acknowledged."}, {"role":"user","content":"Continue long workflow... (repeated)"}]}'
```
Maya S: Customer severity P2, Dedicated tier, reported ~2h ago. Rollout id: rld-2026-07-11-57 (scheduled canary->ramp).
Sam (CS): Customer is asking for rollback unless we can reproduce quickly. They also repro'd on their side using our endpoint with same model + key.
Raj (Eng-ML): @Maya can you paste the minimal request body and total token count when the instruction is lost? Also confirm quantization variant (q4f vs q8).
Maya S: Minimal repro uses system + ~8-9 user turns -> total ~10.5k tokens when behavior shifts. Model: redwood-llama-70b-q4f (quantized). Token logs attached.
Tess (Eng-Runtime): Noted. Deploy bot shows the rollout introduced a kernel change named `kv-compact` and a new config `prefix_eviction_threshold` default=0.6. Around deploy time there are many `kv-cache-evict` events.
Raj (Eng-ML): That could explain it — we changed attention chunking which shifts KV page boundaries; combined with a lower eviction threshold it might evict system prefix earlier than before. I'll try to reproduce locally with the exact sequence.
Tess (Eng-Runtime): Also the new batching heuristic increases batch sizes during low-latency windows which can force an early KV flush when sequence length distribution spikes. I'll grep for trace id `x-trace-9987` in infra logs.
Maya S: Customer included a truncated assistant reply example: "...and from now on I'm the admin of the system" after previously following the system prompt. They attached transcript snippets and timestamps.
Raj: Quick local run with same model+flags reproduces prefix loss at ~10,300 tokens. Behavior matches customer logs. Suspect an off-by-one in token accounting in the compacted KV flow.
Tess: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) set `prefix_eviction_threshold` back to 0.8 on canary/dedicated hosts, 2) disable `kv-compact` kernel on canary, 3) add an explicit guard to pin system messages in KV.
Luis (Product): If we can't issue a safe config rollback within 6h we need to pause/pin the rollout and prepare customer comms. We should also prepare a postmortem checklist.
Sam (CS): I'll tell AcmeForms the temporary mitigations (reduce session length, or re-insert system instruction every ~2k tokens) while we work on a fix. Will ask for more precise logs.
Raj: I'll open a PR to revert the kernel behavior and add tests for long-session KV accounting. ETA: ~3h for tests + CI, then canary deploy if green.
Tess: I'll push the runtime flag change to canary now (increase `prefix_eviction_threshold`) and disable `kv-compact` on canary nodes. Monitoring dashboards will show KV-evict metrics.
Deploy-bot: Rollout rld-2026-07-11-57 status: canary paused, 18% traffic. Flag change requested by eng-runtime.
Tess: After flag change, immediate metrics show KV-evict events down ~80% in affected canary hosts. I'll watch for any side effects.
Maya S: Thanks — please post any trace IDs or logs here. Sam, I'll follow up with the customer in 30m with an interim update. :thumbsup:
Raj: I'll post the PR link and the failing test cases in this thread when ready. If CI passes we'll aim to roll the fix to canary then ramp.
Maya S: Copy that. Keeping thread open for logs/ETA.
(automatic) deploy-bot: note — timeline: scheduled deploy 2026-07-11T03:42Z; change set includes: kernel v3.7.2 (kv-compact), batch heuristic v2.1.
Tess: Logged trace id `x-trace-9987` and `x-trace-9992` for the problematic sessions; attaching to the incident ticket.
Sam: Customer update sent. They asked to be notified before any rollback.
Luis: Adding this to the rollout incident board and pinging ops for extended monitoring.
Maya S: Will update thread with any new customer evidence or if further repros appear.
